Pricing

Acme publishes fixed prices for every standard job.

Callout pricing

An emergency callout costs 2,500 PKR. The callout fee includes the first hour of labour. Parts are billed separately at cost plus 10 percent.

Installation pricing

A full bathroom installation starts at 85,000 PKR. Acme quotes every installation before any work begins, and the quote is held for 30 days.
